subject: Marine Works - Powerline - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Powerline - Fraser River
BC Hydro will be replacing the powerline crossing the channel at the Westham Island Bridge at 49 04.808N 123 07.743W.
Hours of operation from 1500 UTC 09 Nov to 0000 UTC 10 Nov. 
Contact River Tec vessels on site for waterway restrictions.
